intentAlignment.reason: The release Work Item binds reviewed source, an immutable public artifact, isolated adopter acceptance, and installation without expanding into the next reference-source parity batch.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The reviewed source commit, annotated tag, archives, checksums, SBOM, provenance, and release manifest are identity-bound.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: reviewed source commit produces the v0.2.58 public release
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run strict release policy and version consistency checks, merge the reviewed PR, push the annotated tag only after close, and inspect the public Release assets.

scenarioCoverage.reason: The public v0.2.58 Release does not exist until the reviewed source is merged and tagged.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: public v0.2.58 binary governs a fresh isolated adopter
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run adopter acceptance against the immutable v0.2.58 Release without a source or workspace binary fallback.

scenarioCoverage.reason: N-1 acceptance is a post-release boundary and cannot run before publication.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: v0.2.58 upgrades an existing repository without cross-repository state
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run N-1 acceptance with isolated HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR, and CARGO_HOME using the v0.2.57 and v0.2.58 public artifacts.

scenarioCoverage.reason: Installation acceptance requires the public v0.2.58 artifact.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: installing the published binary on the Runtime repository remains healthy
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Install the public artifact, then run inspect, status, doctor, Agent doctor, and documentation promotion checks.
